defects.description: Incorrect translation of the term “brute force attacks”. The required Russian equivalent is “атаки методом грубой силы”.
Nonsensical word “клетка” inserted in the tip sentence, breaking readability.
Awkward phrasing and missing punctuation in the sentence about reloading the configuration file.
